name: Password Sign-In MFA Required
summary: Accepts a valid password for an identity that still requires an additional authentication factor, without issuing an authenticated application session. Provider-specific client routing is a presentation responsibility and does not create a separate server transition.

guards.expression: password authentication is accepted and the account requires an additional factor before application sign-in can complete

sourceReferences.note: Maps Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.SignInResult.RequiresTwoFactor to AuthenticationResponseState.MfaRequired without completing application sign-in.
Emits this transition when the successful manager result carries AuthenticationResponseState.MfaRequired.
Allows the MFA-required transition through the stable password-login application boundary.
Provider-specific TOTP or passkey navigation is modeled as response-directed client routing after this generic server outcome.
